# asc_ips (Data Source)

Lists the IP addresses currently reserved for a tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asc_ips" "reserved" {}

output "reserved_ips" {
  value = [for ip in data.asc_ips.reserved.ips : ip.ip]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ips` (Attributes List) Reserved IP addresses, sorted by address so an entry keeps its index when ASC returns them in another order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ips))

<a id="nestedatt--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ips`

Read-Only:

- `allocated_to` (String) URN of the workload the address is allocated to, null while it is free. Compare it e.g. with asc_virtual_machine.urn.
- `ip` (String) The IP address.
- `reserved_at` (String) Time at which the address was reserved.
